newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO'S BENECOL WINS FOOD INDUSTRY AWARD.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO'S BENECOL WINS FOOD INDUSTRY AWARD.

text.p: Finnish food group Raision Tehtaat Oy's cholesterol-reducing Benecol margarine was among the winners of the annual food product competition held by the Finnish Food and Drinks Industry, the lobby said on Tuesday.

"A functional, health-affecting product, a good example, that Finnish research and development and a (Finnish) product can also compete internationally," the lobby said in a statement describing Benecol margarine.

Benecol margarine and Bioferme Oy's YOSA yoghurt-like product were singled out for awards in the retail product series, while Atria Oy's turkey product range and Puljonki Oy's Optimi sauce products won awards in the catering industry series, it said.

Helsingin Mylly Oy's Myllarin Leipaaines rye bread ingredient was the top winner of the retail product series, and Raisio unit Melia Oy's oat pasta took the top award in the catering industry category, the lobby said.
